# Source (lib/HLSL/DxilCondenseResources.cpp, function UpdateResourceSymbols):
#
#   auto UpdateResourceSymbol = [](DxilResourceBase *res) {
#     if (GlobalVariable *GV = dyn_cast<GlobalVariable>(res->GetGlobalSymbol())) {
#       GV->removeDeadConstantUsers();
#       DXASSERT(GV->user_empty(), "else resource not lowered");
#       res->SetGlobalSymbol(UndefValue::get(GV->getType()));
#       if (GV->user_empty())
#         GV->eraseFromParent();
#     }
#   };
#
# Under NDEBUG (every shipped release binary) the DXASSERT compiles out and execution
# falls through: GV keeps its real user (the first buffer.Store, which runs before the
# dynamic ResourceDescriptorHeap handle gets created/hoisted), so GV is NOT erased, but its
# DxilResourceBase symbol IS replaced with undef -- leaving a stale, metadata-unreferenced
# global for the validator to flag as "External declaration ... is unused". That is exactly
# the issue's reported symptom. Under a Debug build the assert traps first and the validator
# never runs, so ground truth observes an internal compiler error instead of that text.
